notes.title: ver 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
・Fixed an issue where using the weapon Smoke Bomb or support cards with similar effects in certain situations could cause the game to crash.
・Fixed an issue where rerolling weapons as Warden could result in enhanced weapons appearing earlier than intended.
・Fixed an issue where weapons marked for recycling would disappear upon entering a shop during a run.
・Fixed an issue where the Boss Dragon’s actions were not processed correctly in some cases.
・Fixed an issue where volume changes made using the controller’s D-pad were not applied correctly.
・Fixed an issue where, after dealing massive damage to certain bosses, their HP display and next action would not update correctly.
・Fixed an issue where incorrect sprites were shown when certain enemies were knocked back.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
・In the tutorial’s free practice section, the game will now automatically proceed after 15 turns.
・A cursor will now appear when selecting certain menu options using the controller’s D-pad.

notes.title: ver 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Difficulty Adjustment[/h3]
・Reduced the maximum number of "Battle Blow Fish" enemies that can appear simultaneously in Area 2.

The "Battle Blow Fish" could appear in large numbers after looping, which significantly increased the difficulty to the point where it became hard to deal with them without specific cards.
To address this, I have lowered the maximum number that can appear at once to ease the difficulty.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
・Fixed an issue where some button mappings were reversed when playing with an Xbox controller.
・Fixed an issue where one of the adjacent Slime Bomb tiles would fail to detonate when both were triggered simultaneously.
・Fixed an issue where some damage predictions were not displayed correctly.

notes.title: ver 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
・Fixed an issue where using a support card that sets movement power to 1 in certain situations could cause the game to crash.
・Fixed an issue where loading a saved game in certain situations could cause the game to crash.

notes.title: ver 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
・Fixed an issue where performing certain actions could cause the game to crash when changing areas.
・Fixed an issue where performing certain actions could prevent action cards from being selected after changing areas.

・Fixed an issue where some damage predictions were not displayed correctly.
・Fixed an issue in certain boss fights where the enemy could act multiple times after transforming due to burn damage.
・Fixed an issue where changes were not applied to action cards on the turn immediately after obtaining a new weapon or swapping weapons.

・Fixed an issue where the description text was not updated after using a support card that sets movement power to 1.
・Fixed an issue where the boss HP bar was not displayed correctly after performing a save & load in certain situations.
・Fixed typographical errors and missing text in some parts of the game.

notes.title: ver 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
・Fixed an issue where performing certain actions in the tutorial could prevent progress.
・Fixed an issue where fullscreen settings were not applied correctly.

notes.title: Now on sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033231/af2fd58e9a2eb01d914197ddf23ced0628a96e1b.png[/img]

Hello everyone.

Golden Warden, a roguelike battle game that uses a simple dice-rolling system, is now available to purchase from today, March 6th (Japan time). Players will advance step by step in pursuit of the treasure said to be at the very end of the dungeon. Choose from a variety of challengers with different abilities, such as Knight-chan and Hunter-chan, and enjoy the different ways each character fights.

Of course, after you've cleared the game, there are game modes that allow you to further explore the depths of the game. And if you like the BGM in the game, please be sure to check out the “Original Soundtrack” that is being released at the same time. It's a wonderful soundtrack with 13 tracks composed by rotteruo!

Now, the door to the dungeon has been opened!
Overcome the various difficulties that arise along the way, fight the guardian Warden-chan, and get your hands on the treasure!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348700/Golden_Warden_Original_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Dev report: January 2025
notes.content:
Hello.

The December 2024 issue of “Waku Waku Games News”, which provides the latest information on “Golden Warden”, was released at the end of last year. The game is almost complete, and we will let you know when the release date is decided.
[previewyoutube=o6he1tLjyPE;full][/previewyoutube]

We will also be releasing an original soundtrack to accompany the game as DLC.
It consists of all 13 tracks from the game, composed by rotteruo. If you like the game, please check it out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348700/

We will also be sending you the latest screenshots from the development build!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033231/c3764995dff0e9a4e5a72fbc222a476fb8a32d52.png[/img]
The rules of the game are simple. You just need to choose the right action for the number on the dice and the card you draw. The number on the dice allows you to move forward, and the card shows you the action you can perform when you stop on that square. You can choose from a variety of attack cards, including swords, magic, bows, bombs, and blunderbusses, and move forward through the dungeon, which is full of traps that change each time you play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033231/52b7b045219e41b304b961aaa5ee79e052d7b5e6.png[/img]
There are also shops run by mysterious creatures (?) inside the dungeon. You can buy and sell items to strengthen your weapons and armor and give you an advantage in battle. You can only hold a limited number of items, and as is the rule of roguelike games, if you die, everything disappears.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033231/af2fd58e9a2eb01d914197ddf23ced0628a96e1b.png[/img]
↑Unique bosses also await you in the dungeons. They each have different attack methods, and they stand in your way as a source of player frustration. Be careful and think about the terrain effects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033231/333db3c2ec43143208baa71f754705c855631dff.png[/img]
↑There are various terrain effects in the dungeon. Sticky floors will immobilize you and cause damage. Magma-like floors cause burns and deal damage for multiple turns. It becomes a game of reading the dice and map composition. It is essential to keep a good balance of cards in your hand without using cards that are too one-sided.

We want to release Golden Warden before the start of the new school year, so we are currently making final adjustments for release. This game is also excellent with the Steam Deck, so please look forward to it, rogue-like fans and PvE-type card battle fans. :)

notes.title: Golden Warden Demo out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033231/69219d4f8f7f846e8797cbdcb647322d623ae29b.png[/img]

Hello. “Golden Warden Demo” is now available.

In the demo, you can play the first stage using two characters, “Knight-chan”, who excels in defense and melee attacks, and “Hunter-chan”, who excels in traps and long-range attacks.

The full version is scheduled for release in early 2025.
We look forward to your playing the game!
